<thought>The carbon NMR shows peaks at 151.10, 144.35, 140.45, 137.05, 131.30 (two), 124.40, 122.30, 119.00, and 116.65 (two) ppm, all within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110‑160 ppm). The peak at 166.00 ppm is a carbonyl, not aromatic. Counting the aromatic-region peaks gives 11 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>11</final_answer>
